title: spec_guard_census tool contract (P0 seam)
description: Input/output contract + semantics for the host census tool. P0 freezes this contract; P1 implements it. Source of truth: hive-research/vv-cross-scope-impact-rd.md §14.5 (round-6), §14.3, §14.1, §20. The census is a HOST tool (typescript runtime dep + git worktree + filesystem); the lint.ts verdict engine stays zero-dependency and only compares host-supplied values.
x-status: P0 frozen contract — not yet implemented

repoRoot.description: Absolute git root of the repository holding the .vvoc package.

baselineRef.description: Committed OID (resolve relative revs like af92a878^ via git rev-parse FIRST). Immutable pin; the worktree is materialized here.

currentRef.description: Optional current OID for stale-impact drift comparison (baseline vs current). Requires a second program.

scopeDir.description: Package/repo ROOT (repo-relative), NOT src/backend, so schema/contract barrel consumers are visible. Per-scope aggregation is downstream.

ownerScope.description: Scope declaring the deleted symbol; excluded from consumer fan-out. If omitted, the host resolves the symbol's declaration scope at baselineRef.

deletedSymbols.description: Symbols being removed. PLAN-DERIVED from plan <deletes>/<renames>; census-incomplete checks plan ⊆ spec-pinned set.

deletedPaths.description: Files being removed. Host extracts each path's exported symbols via TS API at baselineRef. A path that fails resolution → census-path-unresolvable error.

renamedSymbols.description: From plan <renames>. Census queries the FROM (old) name consumers at baseline; the TO target need not exist at baseline.

resolvedOid.description: git rev-parse of baselineRef (not the spelled ref).

version.description: Exact ts.version, no caret. Part of the digest: a version change alters edges.

resolutionStrategy.description: How @foundation/* workspace links were materialized (mirrored-pnpm-links | injected-resolver). Part of the digest. Wholesale live-node_modules symlink is FORBIDDEN (breaks ref-pinning).

perScope.description: Production consumer scopes (owner scope excluded; test/generated excluded from fan-out).

scope.description: First segment under src/backend; src/db→S-DB, src/contracts→S-CONTRACTS, other src/<seg>→S-PKG-<SEG>.

files.description: Repo-relative paths (sorted, no ref prefix, NO line) of files with >=1 hard edge. NOT all files in the scope.

source.description: Repo-relative file path, NO line number (line shifts cause false stale-impact drift).

hardCount.description: |edges with kind ∈ {runtime-import, type-import, schema-barrel, contract-barrel}| — all four are hard for contradiction AND fan-out (§14.1). Closeout depth differs (type-import compile-only).

advisory.description: Test/generated edges (reported, NOT threshold-driving). Requires building the program from an explicit file list including tests, since the domain tsconfig excludes them.

outputDigest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON form (§14.3): {schemaVersion, analyzer, resolutionStrategy, resolvedOid, scopeDir, ownerScope, sortedDeletedSymbols, sortedDeletedPaths, sortedRenamedPairs, perScope}. Code-point sort; canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, fixed escaping); schemaVersion bump invalidates prior digests.

semantics.materialization: git worktree add --detach <uniqueTmp> <resolvedOid>. Worktree has ONLY tracked files (no node_modules). Mirror pnpm per-entry RELATIVE symlinks into the worktree OR inject a resolver mapping @foundation/<pkg>/<sub> → <worktree>/packages/platform/<pkg>/<sub> from pnpm-workspace.yaml globs. FORBID symlinking the live checkout node_modules wholesale (resolves to LIVE tree, breaks ref-pinning). lib.es*.d.ts comes from the host typescript install. projects/* are gitlinks (worktree empty — v1 submodule deferral); packages/platform/* are main-repo trees (present).
semantics.resolution: ts.createProgram with the worktree tsconfig (moduleResolution: bundler honored). Named-binding extraction, barrel re-export traversal (export * from), workspace package.json export-map subpaths.
semantics.diUsage: runtime-import = a reference in a non-elided value position OR a parameter/property type of a DECORATED class when emitDecoratorMetadata is on (Nest DI injects via constructor-param type annotations — a RUNTIME edge, not type-only). type-import = import type / elided type-only reference. Fixture: examinations/exam.controller.ts = runtime-import.
semantics.edgeKindPrecedence: schema-barrel = deleted symbol declared under db/schemas (Drizzle table); contract-barrel = deleted symbol under contracts (oRPC slice). Barrel kind takes precedence over runtime-import by declaring-module path origin.
semantics.hostEngineSplit: The HOST recomputes the census and passes censusDigest/censusStale into SpecLintOptions (like §K currentSha256). lint ONLY compares; it never re-runs the census (purity invariant lint.ts:183-184).
semantics.lifecycle: Unique tmp dir per run; try/finally with git worktree remove --force + git worktree prune; per-repo lock keyed by (resolvedOid, scopeDir) for concurrent spec/plan/pre-flight runs.
semantics.perfCache: createProgram ~2s / getTypeChecker ~0.5s over the domain (measured); ~10-30s per full run. Cache output by (resolvedOid, deletedSet, scopeDir, tsVersion, resolutionStrategy). stale-impact needs two programs (baseline + current).
semantics.acceptance: Witness assertion (qualitative, robust): examinations ∈ runtime-import consumers of SchoolAuthorizationService at af92a878^ (DI constructor-param edge). Exact production scope/file count is census-tool-derived (symbol-only ≈5 scopes / 6 import-binding files), NOT a grep mention count. Full deletion surface via deletedPaths captures barrel consumers.
